book.name: Joŋ
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Joŋ gɛ̀ Saŋ

content: Jiso bɛ kwɛse wumu wu Samaliya tasɛ fɛ fwɛŋ wu joo le
Jiso gɛ̀ kɛɛ lɛ Bafalashii le bo yu lɛ wu lɛne bamii ba ŋgoo bo too wu leese bo a joo fede Joŋ.
Geenɛ gɛ nyu wu wù gɛ̀ leese bo a joo gɛ, gɛ̀ leese booŋ be ba ŋgoo lɛ maa.
Wu doo wu kɛɛ noo, wu mo wu ja a kimbe ki woŋ kì Judia kiyu le, wu kaase wu tuu jiŋ kì Galalee le.
Wu gɛ̀ kɛme ki wu fê je kimbe ki Samaliya le.
Wu gɛ gɛɛŋ wu bu a kilaantɛŋ ki Samaliya kimi le ki ba gɛ tɛŋe lɛ Sika, ki le mbebe mwɛ wu Yakob gɛ nya mwa ye wu Yosɛf le.
Fwɛŋ wu joo wu Yakob gɛ̀ chiŋ gɛ̀ bee fo. No Jiso gɛ̀ jiɛnyɛ wa baaŋ wu fwɛɛŋ, wu mo wu shii mbebe fwɛŋ wu joo kwɛɛ le. Kife gɛ̀ bee njɛ juu bikaa ncho bifɛɛ fɛnshɛ.
Kwɛse wumu wu Samaliya gɛ̀ to ki wu tûu joo fo, Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nya mɛ bɛ joo mu.”

content: Gɛ̀ bee booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso gɛɛŋ alaantɛŋ ki bo gu mwɛɛ munjile.
Kwɛse wɛɛ biih Jiso le lɛ, “Wo le muh wu Bajuu, nle muh wu Samaliya, wo ge nɛ fɛ wo tu wo lɛge joo a mɛne?” Kwɛse wɛɛ gɛ̀ duu noo, nje Bajuu gɛ̀ nyiɛŋse lo bamii ba Samaliya.
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ wo be kee nnya yì le yi Nyo, mo muh wù duu wo le lɛ wo nyâ wu bɛ joo, tu wo be wo lɛgɛ lɛ wu nyâ wo bɛ joo yì bohge segechii.”

content: Kwɛse wɛɛ kaasɛ wu biih Jiso le lɛ, “Chii, njɛ wo kɛme fiɛɛ fì wo tuu joo yo sɛŋ, fwɛŋ kfunɛ shiide nɛ, wo lé wo jô faaŋ yɛɛ joo yi boge segechii?
Fi le lɛ wo kuge wo fede chiji wese wù Yakob wù gɛ̀ chiŋ fwɛŋ kfunɛ wu gɛɛ bee le, wu kibɛɛ gɛ̀ mu joo yo, booŋ be mu, nyáŋ ye tɛ mu?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Muh wuchii wù muu joo yinɛ kindoŋ baaŋ ki yune wu.

Geenɛ, nɛ le yɛɛŋ wù lé wu gê wu mû joo yì nlé ŋgê nyâ, gɛ kindoŋ baaŋ ki ka ki yune wu gɛ. Joo yì nlé nyâ wu le, lé yi jâ yi tû nchweŋ wu joo yì bude yi ye ye le segechii, yi lé yi jîɛnyɛ yi tô yi nyâ wu kinche kì kage gɛ.”

content: Kwɛse wɛɛ mo wu jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Chii, nya mɛ bɛ kfuu chi yinɛ joo yi le lɛ keefɛ kindoŋ ka ki yune mɛ gɛ, ŋgɛ ŋka ntoo fɛnɛ ki ntuude joo gɛ.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Gɛnɛ wo tɛɛŋ jwɛɛŋ, bena wu to.”

content: Kwɛse wuyu chvuu wu le lɛ, “Gɛ ŋkɛme jwɛŋsɛ gɛ.” Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo le wo jɛmɛ chuule no wo jɛmɛ lɛ gɛ wo kɛme jwɛŋsɛ gɛ.
Wo gɛ̀ kɛme wa bilɛŋsɛ batɛŋ, wu bena wu le mɛɛse gɛ nyu mo jwɛɛŋ wo gɛ. Fiɛɛ fì wo jɛme le nchiɛɛŋ.”

content: Kwɛse wɛɛ jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Chii, nle n'yɛŋ mɛɛse lɛ wo le muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo.
Bachiji besa gɛ̀ shee bo buune Nyo yi mbegɛ wunɛ le, bɛŋ Bajuu duu fiena lɛ fɛ bamii kɛme ki bo buune Nyo fo le gɛh Yɛlusalɛm.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Kwɛse, bɛ̂ɛŋ fiɛɛ fì njɛme finɛ. Kife too lo kì bɛŋ lé bɛŋ bûune Nyo wù Chii ka nyume gɛ yi mbegɛ wunɛ le gɛ, kɛnɛ Yɛlusalɛm gɛ.
Bɛŋ bamii ba Samaliya buune fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ kee gɛ, bee Bajuu buune be kee fiɛɛ fì bee buune, nje mbvusɛ jade fɛ Bajuu le.
Geenɛ, kife too lo, ki to wa, kì bamii ba buune Nyo nchiɛɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lé bo gê bo bûune Nyo wù Chii a kiyo le bɛ yi nchiɛɛŋ le. Le kfuu chi bamii ba Nyo wù Chii goone lɛ bo buune wu.
Nyo le Kiyo, bamii ba buune wu bo kɛme ki bo buune a kiyo le bɛ yi nchiɛɛŋ le.”

content: Kwɛse wɛɛ jɛmɛ Jiso le lɛ, “Ŋkee lɛ Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka too lo, wù ba tɛŋe lɛ Kletu. Sege wu doo wu to, wu mo wu najɛ mwɛɛ munchii bee le.”
Jiso jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Mɛ wunɛ wù njɛme wo le le mɛ wuyu.”

content: Gɛh segeyu, booŋ ba Jiso ba ŋgoo mo bo kaasɛ bo to. Jwe yuŋ lo bo no wu jɛme bɛ kwɛse wɛɛ. Geenɛ, muh mu bo le gɛ̀ baaŋ biih gɛ wu le laa wu goone la lɛ, kɛnɛ lɛ Jiso jɛme bɛ kwɛse wɛɛ nje la lɛ.
Kwɛse wɛɛ mo wu gɛɛ shaaŋ ye yi joo fo, wu gɛɛŋ alaantɛŋ, wu gɛɛŋ wu be bamii lɛ,
“Bɛŋ tô bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ muh mu le wu to wu sɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fichii fì ŋgɛ̀ ŋge wa. Taŋlo muh wunɛ nyume Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka?”
Bamii bu alaantɛŋ bo gɛɛne fɛ Jiso le.
Gɛ̀ bee booŋ ba ŋgoo ba Jiso shɛɛ wa bo lɛge Jiso bo duu wu le lɛ, “Labai, jî mwɛɛ.”
Geenɛ, Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋkɛme mwɛɛ munjile mù njii gɛ bɛŋ kee mu gɛ.”

content: Booŋ be ba ŋgoo mo bo gha lɛbolɛbo lɛ, “Muh le wu shɛɛ wu to bɛ mwɛɛ munjile wu nya wu le?”
Jiso jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Mwɛɛ munjile mwaŋ le lɛ ŋge fiɛɛ fì muh wu tuŋ mɛ goone, lɛ mɛ mɛsɛ lɛme che chichii.
Gɛ bɛŋ duu fiena lɛ shɛshi gɛh kii yinɛh, mo nyu kife ki ŋgwejɛ gɛ? Nduu bɛŋ le lɛ, bɛŋ chîaasɛ ajii we bɛŋ jîŋɛ bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ no mwɛɛ le wa ŋɛɛ le no ba gwejɛ.
Muh wù gweji kɛme nlaŋe we, wu baanyi ŋgu wu gɛɛde yi kinche kì kage gɛ le, noo le muh wù boone bɛ muh wù gwejɛ mo bo laŋeye yi muh le wu mumwaa.
Finɛ fiɛɛ duunyi lɛ ŋgaŋ wunɛ le nchiɛɛŋ wù duu lɛ, ‘Muh mu boone, muh mu gwejɛ.’
Ntuŋ bɛŋ lɛ bɛŋ gɛɛŋ bɛŋ gwejɛ mwɛɛ mù bɛŋ gɛ baaŋ lɛŋ gɛ. Bamii bamu le bo booŋ, bɛŋ lee bvujoŋɛ bvu lɛme chiboo le.”

content: Bamii ba Samaliya ba duude lee muntele yi Jiso le
Bamii ba Samaliya ba duude a kilaantɛŋ kiyu le gɛ̀ lee muntele yi Jiso le nje fiɛɛ fì kwɛse wɛɛ gɛ̀ jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, “Wu be wu sɛɛŋ lo mɛ fiɛɛ fichii fì ŋgɛ̀ ŋge wa.”
Noo, bo doo bo to bo yɛŋ Jiso le, bo lɛgɛ lɛ bɛ bo che. Wu bɛɛŋ, bɛ bo che aju afaa.
Bamii ba duude ka bo leesɛ muntele yi Jiso le nje jɛmɛ we.
Bamii baa jɛmɛ kwɛse wɛɛ le lɛ, “Bee le be leesɛ muntele yi ye ye le, ka nyu gɛ nje njɛmɛ wo gɛ. Bee le be yu wa bɛ bintuŋ biɛsa, bee kɛɛ lɛ muh wunɛ le Mbvusɛ wù woŋ kfunɛ wu nchiɛɛŋ.”
Jiso fɛ mwa muh wù baaŋ
Lɛ aju fe afaa, Jiso ja wu gɛɛne Galalee.
Wu kibɛɛ gɛ̀ bee wu yu wu jɛmɛ lɛ gɛ ba to ba ŋgvuune muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo woŋ we le gɛ.
Wu gɛ̀ doo wu gɛɛŋ wu fɛsɛ Galalee, bamii ba yo fi wu nje bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ mwɛɛ mu wu gɛ̀ ge fɛ ŋka le Yɛlusalɛm, nje bo tɛ gɛ̀ bee fɛ ŋka wɛɛ le.
Jiso ka wu kaasɛ wu gɛɛŋ Kana wu a kimbe kì Galalee le, a wu gɛ̀ kaasɛ joo yo yi tu mbvuuŋ. Gɛ̀ bee muh wù baaŋ wumu nyu a kilaantɛŋ kì Kafanahum le, mwa ye wù jwɛŋsɛ chɛne.
Muh wù baaŋ wɛɛ doo wu yu lɛ Jiso le wu ja wa Judia wu too Galalee, wu gɛɛŋ fɛ wu le, wu ku chiaaŋ lɛ wu boh wu to wu fɛ mwa ye, lɛ wu le wa jwe wu kwe le.
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ bɛŋ le njɛ bɛŋ yɛŋ mwɛɛ mù duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Nyo le sɛŋ, bɛŋ nɛ baaŋ yɛŋ gɛ tɛ mwɛɛ mu jwe wu yune le sɛŋ, bɛŋ gɛ leesɛ fitele yi ye yaŋ le gɛ.”

content: Muh wù baaŋ wɛɛ jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Chii, tô gɛh be bohge lo, fɛ mwa yaŋ kwe gɛ.”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Wo gɛ̂ɛne, mwa yo le yu.”

content: Muh wɛɛ gɛ̀ bɛɛŋ fiɛɛ fì Jiso jɛme wu le, wu mo wu ja wu gɛɛne.
No wu gɛ̀ boge, bɛ booŋ be ba lɛme lɛ tasɛ, bo sɛɛŋ wu le lɛ mwa wɛɛ le yu.
Noo, wu biih bo kife ki wu chi kɛ̂ wu tɛɛme. Bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Chi bee njɛ juu kikaa kimimia fɛnshɛ, kin'ya kiyu mo ki chinɛ wu le.”
Chiji mwa wɛɛ mo wu kwajɛ lɛ le kife kiyu kì Jiso chi jɛme wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Mwa yo le yu.”

content: Wu bɛ yeh ye yichii mo bo leesɛ muntele yi Jiso le.
Finɛ fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvukugɛ bvu Jiso, gɛ̀ bee fi kiŋgane kinfɛɛ fì wu gɛ̀ ge sege wu gɛ̀ ja Judia wu to Galalee.
